title: Kenya’s railway corridor and two counties gain connected service accounts
summary: Mombasa–Nairobi SGR, Nairobi City County and Mombasa County gain distinct accounts of railway operation, neighbourhood facilities and local service dependencies. Eligibility reaches 78 projects and 46 places, not a completed-portfolio total.
evidence_note: Fourteen official HTML bodies and selected county-plan PDF prose inspected November 22. PDF visual rendering and unavailable-page limits are explicit. Opening, construction, framework approval, targets and reported delivery retain distinct meanings.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and cycle identities remain intact. No comparable outcome-series admission, production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or stewardship completion is created.
